summary: The whole board, six panels and both lines. Shots 01, 05 and 06 have a second take — the compositions are close, so pick on faces and light.

notes.text: The upturned chairs read in both takes. The first take keeps the owner a little smaller, which leaves the window to the girl.
Cut along the wide's axis from 01's panel, so her place at the window carries across. The line lands at 0.6s.
He is looking past camera right, toward her table. The umbrella is planted in the stand by the door, right of frame.
Insert at the stand. The hand enters from the upper right, the same side he stood on in 03.
The handle points at her so the offer reads before he speaks.
Last image: the only warm colour outside is the umbrella. The title will sit over this hold.
